label: D-Link DPN-100 Rev C1 GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT built into an SFP module (CIG G-97S ODM, Realtek RTL9601CI, Linux Luna SDK 1.9.0) that presents itself to the host router as an HSGMII Ethernet interface at 2.5 Gbit/s; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on SC/APC with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over telnet.
